newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose.

text.p: Total money market mutual fund assets rose to $970.88 billion in the week ended June 4 from a slightly revised $961.65 billion the prior week, an industry group said Thursday.
The Investment Company Institute said assets of the nation's 663 retail money market mutual funds rose $5.01 billion to $645.05 billion in the week.
Of the retail funds, assets of the 403 taxable money market funds rose $3.21 billion to $529.78 billion, while assets of the 260 tax-exempt funds rose $1.8 billion to $115.26 billion, the group said.

ICI said assets of the 322 institutional money market funds rose $4.21 billion to $325.83 billion. Of these, assets of the 260 taxable money market funds increased $2.92 billion to $290.93 billion, while assets of the 62 tax-exempt funds rose $1.29 billion to $34.90 billion, it said.
ICI revised last week's money market mutual fund assets to $961.65 billion from $961 billion.
